newsitem.title: CONGO: Three killed in intra-militia clash in Congo.
newsitem.headline: Three killed in intra-militia clash in Congo.

text.p: At least three people were killed during fighting among members of a militia group loyal to Congo's former president Denis Sassou Nguesso, opposition sources said on Wednesday.
The clashes erupted on Monday in the northern commune of Oyo, about 400 km (250 miles) from the capital Brazzaville, after a dispute over pay, they said.
Sassou Nguesso has been in France for more than a year.

More than 3,000 people died in militia battles in the capital Brazzaville after disputed elections in 1993. Militia groups were officially dissolved after political parties signed a peace accord in 1995, but most merely moved from the capital to regional strongholds of their leaders.
